raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 CRM migration, some customers carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. silver_customers passes these codes through unmapped, which splits gold_region_daily into bogus regions; the documented raw_region_map (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH) resolves them to the existing name domain.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
